 MS. JIRGA JHAVERI APP for the Appellant(s) No. 1  MR YV VAGHELA, ADVOCATE for the Opponent(s)/Respondent(s) No. 1  ==========================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE A.G.URAIZEE  Date : 09/09/2017
[1] The appeal is taken up for Settlement in Lok Adalat.
[2] Ms. Jirga Jhaveri, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor has appeared on behalf of the State and has produced withdrawal/settlement pursis, which is taken on record.
The withdrawal/settlement pursis is signed by the authorized signatory, which is presented in person in the Court, and the pursis is counter signed by learned APP.

[3] It is submitted that the offeence alleged against the accused persons under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, is not serious in nature, the penalty/punishment HC-NIC Page 1 of 2 Created On Sat Sep 16 12:04:12 IST 2017 R/CR.A/1376/2016 ORDER prescribed for such offence is not substantial, and in view of the Sections 51 and 52 of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006, it is compoundable under Section 69 of the Act.
